title: Operator connector first-run visual guides and install/upgrade micro-interactions
creator: Ava Morozov
description: Create a compact, developer-focused visual guide set for first-run operator connector setup (VPC/Private). Deliverables include a step-by-step install flow for both Console-first and CLI-first users, an animated upgrade UI pattern, network diagnostics overlay artwork, and a screenshot pack for docs. Emphasis on clear microcopy, machine-friendly screenshots (no PII), and accessibility annotations for handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file with annotated frames covering Console-first and CLI-first flows
Animated upgrade modal prototype and exported MP4/GIFs for docs
Network diagnostics overlay art + 3 fallbacks for common errors (CIDR conflict, DNS resolution, MTU mismatch)
Screenshot pack (light+dark) exported at 2x with developer-visible fields redacted
Design handoff checklist completed and linked in Confluence
Accessibility notes (contrast, keyboard focus states) documented
